ASSURANCE / ROADMAP

From evidence to work.

A governed queue for what assurance reveals: discernment, corrections and missing evidence. Repeated observations become scoped work items, with ownership, dependencies and completion criteria.

Assurance topics · Maturity profiles · Workflow declarations (JSON)

How work moves

Triage → to do → in progress or blocked → verification → done or explicitly accepted. No owner or delivery date is invented. A finding is not automatically a bug; disappearance is not completion.

Closure needs a matching verification key, evidence, method, reviewer and date. Acceptance also needs a rationale. Source observations remain visible and do not change maturity levels when a workflow status changes.
